package service

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

// ProjectAuthoringTZService is deliberately limited to authoring job lifecycle
// and explicit publication. It has no Practice runtime or Sandbox operation.
type ProjectAuthoringTZService interface {
	EnsureAuthoringJob(context.Context, string, domain.TZAuthoringRequestV2) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error)
	GetAuthoringJob(context.Context, string) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error)
	ResumeAuthoringJob(context.Context, string) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error)
	StageAuthoringJob(context.Context, string) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error)
}

type ProjectAuthoringStudentService interface {
	GetPlanningProfile(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentPlanningProfile, error)
	GetLearningPathPlanningState(context.Context, string, string) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error)
}
